name: byted-asset-preparation
description: Determine how to make media suitable for a planned use: retain it, extract components, separate mixed sound, remove unsuitable burned-in captions, adapt its format, or source replacement or additional media through search or generation. Use when these needs arise during planning or editing, even without an explicit processing request. Route execution to relevant specialist skills. Skip routine timeline edits and audio fades or level balancing that require no asset preparation; an already selected, suitable specialist workflow can be followed directly.
